)AS t (app_code, raw_scene_name, scene_l1_name, scene_l2_name)
),

-- 2. 基础日志清洗
base_log AS (
SELECT
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(network_name) = 'instagram installs' THEN 'facebook' ELSE network_name END AS network_name,
  scene_name,
  ad_id,
  revenue_usd,
  activity_kind,
  event_name
FROM bi_ods.ods_user_adjust_log_rt
WHERE dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 days'
  AND dt = installed_at::date
  AND (LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%rm%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%r3%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%fr%'
       OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%vd%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%vc%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%pt%'
       OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%rl%')
),

-- 3. 场景映射
scene_mapped AS (
SELECT
  l.dt,
  l.app_code,
  l.app_version,
  l.country_code,
  l.network_name,
  COALESCE(m.scene_l1_name, l.scene_name) AS standard_scene_name,
  l.ad_id,
  l.revenue_usd,
  l.activity_kind,
  l.event_name
FROM base_log l
LEFT JOIN dim_scene_mapping m
  ON LOWER(l.app_code) = m.app_code
 AND LOWER(l.scene_name) = m.raw_scene_name
),

-- 4. 核心聚合：GROUPING SETS
aggregated_data AS (
SELECT
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  network_name,
  GROUPING(standard_scene_name) AS is_all_row,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(standard_scene_name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE standard_scene_name END AS standard_scene,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN ad_id END) AS ad_user_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS ad_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS ad_profit,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS ad_click_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS temp_user_count
FROM scene_mapped
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  (dt, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name, standard_scene_name),
  (dt, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name)
  ) -- 修正：直接以括号结尾，删掉多余的 AS t (...) 别名
)

-- 5. 主查询：安全空值保护
SELECT
  a.dt AS "日期",
  a.country_code AS "国家",
  a.app_code AS "应用",
  a.app_version AS "版本",
  a.network_name AS "买量渠道",
  CASE WHEN a.is_all_row = 1 THEN a.temp_user_count ELSE NULL END AS "注册用户",
  a.standard_scene AS "标准广告场景",
  a.ad_user_count AS "曝光人数",
  a.ad_count AS "曝光次数",
  a.ad_profit AS "广告收益",
  a.ad_click_count AS "点击次数"
FROM aggregated_data a
WHERE (a.is_all_row = 1 AND a.temp_user_count >= 1)
   OR (a.is_all_row = 0 AND a.ad_user_count >= 1)
ORDER BY a.dt DESC, a.country_code, a.app_code, a.is_all_row DESC, a.standard_scene

  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(network_name) = 'instagram installs' THEN 'facebook' ELSE network_name END AS network_name,
  scene_name,
  ad_id,

  activity_kind,
  event_name

  AND dt = installed_at::date
  AND (LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%rm%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%r3%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%fr%'
       OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%vd%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%vc%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%pt%'
       OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%rl%')

-- 3. 场景映射

SELECT
  l.dt,
  l.app_code,
  l.app_version,
  l.country_code,
  l.network_name,
  COALESCE(m.scene_l2_name, l.scene_name) AS aggregate_scene_name,
  l.ad_id,
  l.revenue_usd,
  l.activity_kind,
  l.event_name
FROM base_log l
LEFT JOIN dim_scene_mapping m
  ON LOWER(l.app_code) = m.app_code
 AND LOWER(l.scene_name) = m.raw_scene_name
),

-- 4. 核心聚合：GROUPING SETS
aggregated_data AS (
SELECT
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  network_name,
  GROUPING(aggregate_scene_name) AS is_all_row,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(aggregate_scene_name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE aggregate_scene_name END AS aggregate_scene,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN ad_id END) AS ad_user_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS ad_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS ad_profit,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS ad_click_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS temp_user_count
FROM scene_mapped
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  (dt, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name, aggregate_scene_name),
  (dt, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name)
  )
)

-- 5. 主查询：安全空值保护
SELECT
  a.dt AS "日期",
  a.country_code AS "国家",
  a.app_code AS "应用",
  a.app_version AS "版本",
  a.network_name AS "买量渠道",
  CASE WHEN a.is_all_row = 1 THEN a.temp_user_count ELSE NULL END AS "注册用户",
  a.aggregate_scene AS "聚合广告场景",
  a.ad_user_count AS "曝光人数",
  a.ad_count AS "曝光次数",
  a.ad_profit AS "广告收益",
  a.ad_click_count AS "点击次数"
FROM aggregated_data a
WHERE (a.is_all_row = 1 AND a.temp_user_count >= 1)
   OR (a.is_all_row = 0 AND a.ad_user_count >= 1)
ORDER BY a.dt DESC, a.country_code, a.app_code, a.is_all_row DESC, a.aggregate_scene
templates.description: 新用户对比 聚合广告场景差异

templates.name: 标准数据
templates.description: 新用户、注册用户>10、D0、最近8天
templates.sql:
WITH
-- 1. 基础日志清洗（严格锁定：仅统计当天注册的新用户在当天的行为）
base_log AS (
SELECT
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  -- 1.1 加上买量渠道清洗
  CASE WHEN LOWER(network_name) = 'instagram installs' THEN 'facebook' ELSE network_name END AS network_name,
  ad_id,
  revenue_usd,
  activity_kind,
  event_name
FROM bi_ods.ods_user_adjust_log_rt
WHERE dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 days'
  AND dt <= CURRENT_DATE
  -- 【核心修正】：限制日志日期等于安装日期，确保所有指标仅针对“当天注册的新用户”
  AND CAST(installed_at AS date) = dt
  AND (LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%rm%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%r3%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%fr%'
       OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%vd%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%vc%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%pt%'
       OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%rl%')
)

-- 2. 直接聚合（全为属性维度，数据完全可累加，无重复和失真风险）
SELECT
  dt AS "日期",
  country_code AS "国家",
  app_code AS "应用",
  app_version AS "版本",
  network_name AS "买量渠道",
  
  -- 2.1 注册用户：因为 base_log 已经锁定了安装日期=日志日期，所以直接对 ad_id 去重即为注册新用户数
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS "注册用户",
  
  -- 2.2 行为级去重指标：当天注册的新用户中，当天产生曝光的去重人数（必然 <= 注册用户）
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN ad_id END) AS "曝光人数",
  
  -- 2.3 行为级累加指标：仅统计当天新用户产生的曝光与点击
  COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS "曝光次数",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS "广告收益",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS "点击次数"
FROM base_log
GROUP BY
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  network_name
-- 2.4 【过滤调整】：过滤掉注册用户（新用户数）小于 10 的记录
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) >= 10
ORDER BY dt DESC, country_code, app_code, network_name;

templates.name: 小时同期表
templates.description: 新用户对比 近期当前时间段 各天差异
templates.sql:
WITH
-- 1. 基础日志清洗
base_log AS (
SELECT
  CAST(installed_at AS date) AS install_date,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(network_name) = 'instagram installs' THEN 'facebook' ELSE network_name END AS network_name,
  ad_id,
  ad_type,
  ad_revenue_network,
  revenue_usd,
  activity_kind,
  event_name,
  (dt - CAST(installed_at AS date)) AS day_x
FROM bi_ods.ods_user_adjust_log_rt
WHERE dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 days'
  AND dt <= CURRENT_DATE
  AND installed_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 days')::text
  AND dt - CAST(installed_at AS date) <= 7
  -- 同期小时对齐：只统计当前整点之前的数据，每天对比口径一致
  AND date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp(created_at)) < date_trunc('hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  AND (LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%rm%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%r3%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%fr%'
       OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%vd%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%vc%' OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%pt%'
       OR LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%rl%')
),

-- 2. 混合粒度聚合（极致性能：利用 GROUPING SETS 实现无 JOIN 计算）
aggregated_data AS (
SELECT
  install_date,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  network_name,
  
  -- 识别当前行是否为大盘 ALL 汇总行：1 代表是，0 代表是明细拆分行
  GROUPING(day_x) AS is_all_row,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(day_x) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE CAST(day_x AS varchar) END AS day_x,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ad_type) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE COALESCE(ad_type, 'Unknown') END AS ad_type,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ad_revenue_network) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE COALESCE(ad_revenue_network, 'Unknown') END AS ad_revenue_network,
  
  -- 行为级去重指标：曝光人数（大盘行和明细行都会准确去重计算）
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN ad_id END) AS ad_user_count,
  
  -- 行为级累加指标
  COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS ad_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS ad_profit,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS ad_click_count,
  
  -- 属性级去重指标：注册用户临时统计（当天该买量渠道新增的总人数）
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS temp_user_count
FROM base_log
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  -- 组合 1：明细拆分层级 (包含生命周期、广告类型、渠道的所有交叉组合)
  (install_date, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name, day_x, ad_type, ad_revenue_network),
  -- 组合 2：新增用户大盘汇总层级 (无任何变现/生命周期拆分)
  (install_date, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name)
)
)

-- 3. 主查询：输出最终平铺表，应用“安全隔离”
SELECT
  a.install_date AS "安装日期",
  a.day_x AS "生命周期",
  a.country_code AS "国家",
  a.app_code AS "应用",
  a.app_version AS "版本",
  a.network_name AS "买量渠道",
  
  -- 【方案 B 安全隔离核心】：注册用户在明细行强制置为 NULL，只有在 ALL 大盘行才输出真实值，完美防止透视表求和暴增
  CASE WHEN a.is_all_row = 1 THEN a.temp_user_count ELSE NULL END AS "注册用户",
  
  a.ad_type AS "广告类型",
  a.ad_revenue_network AS "变现渠道",
  a.ad_user_count AS "曝光人数",
  a.ad_count AS "曝光次数",
  a.ad_profit AS "广告收益",
  a.ad_click_count AS "点击次数"
FROM aggregated_data a
-- 【方案 A 过滤逻辑配合】：
-- 3.1 对于大盘行(is_all_row = 1)，过滤掉注册新用户小于 10 的记录

  SELECT
    dt,
    app_code,
    app_version,

    AND dt = NULLIF(TRIM(installed_at), '')::date  -- 已修复
    AND LOWER(app_code) IN ('rm08c','rm06c', 'rm06d','rm10', 'rm12', 'rm12b', 'rm10b', 'rm14') 
),

-- 3. 场景映射

  SELECT
    l.dt,
    l.app_code,
    l.app_version,
    l.country_code,
    l.network_name,
    COALESCE(m.scene_l1_name, l.scene_name) AS standard_scene_name,

    l.revenue_usd,
    l.activity_kind,
    l.event_name

  LEFT JOIN dim_scene_mapping m
    ON LOWER(l.app_code) = m.app_code
   AND LOWER(l.scene_name) = m.raw_scene_name
),

-- 4. 核心聚合：GROUPING SETS

  SELECT
    dt,
    app_code,
    app_version,
    country_code,
    network_name,

    CASE WHEN GROUPING(standard_scene_name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE standard_scene_name END AS standard_scene,

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS ad_profit,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS ad_click_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS temp_user_count
  FROM scene_mapped
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    -- 组合 1：明细层级
    (dt, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name, standard_scene_name),
    -- 组合 2：大盘汇总层级
    (dt, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name)

)

  a.dt AS "日期",
  a.country_code AS "国家",
  a.app_code AS "应用",
  a.app_version AS "版本",
  a.network_name AS "买量渠道",

FROM aggregated_data a
WHERE (a.is_all_row = 1 AND a.temp_user_count >= 1)
   OR (a.is_all_row = 0 AND a.ad_user_count >= 1)
ORDER BY a.dt DESC, a.country_code, a.app_code, a.is_all_row DESC, a.standard_scene;

-- 2. 基础日志清洗（仅获取 VC 系列应用）
base_log AS (
SELECT
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(network_name) = 'instagram installs' THEN 'facebook' ELSE network_name END AS network_name,
  scene_name,
  ad_id,
  ad_type, -- 添加广告类型字段
  revenue_usd,
  activity_kind,
  event_name

  AND dt = installed_at::date
  AND LOWER(app_code) LIKE '%FR%' -- 此处已简化为只获取 FR 系列
),

-- 3. 场景映射
scene_mapped AS (
SELECT
  l.dt,
  l.app_code,
  l.app_version,
  l.country_code,
  l.network_name,
  COALESCE(m.scene_l1_name, l.scene_name) AS standard_scene_name,
  l.ad_id,
  l.ad_type, -- 传递广告类型字段
  l.revenue_usd,
  l.activity_kind,
  l.event_name
FROM base_log l
LEFT JOIN dim_scene_mapping m
  ON LOWER(l.app_code) = m.app_code
 AND LOWER(l.scene_name) = m.raw_scene_name
),

-- 4. 核心聚合：GROUPING SETS
aggregated_data AS (
SELECT
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  network_name,
  GROUPING(standard_scene_name) AS is_all_row,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(standard_scene_name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE standard_scene_name END AS standard_scene,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ad_type) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE COALESCE(ad_type, 'Unknown') END AS ad_type, -- 处理广告类型聚合值
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN ad_id END) AS ad_user_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS ad_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS ad_profit,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS ad_click_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS temp_user_count
FROM scene_mapped
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  -- 组合 1：明细层级（增加了 ad_type 作为交叉组合）
  (dt, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name, standard_scene_name, ad_type),
  -- 组合 2：大盘汇总层级
  (dt, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name)
  )
)

-- 5. 主查询：安全空值保护
SELECT
  a.dt AS "日期",
  a.country_code AS "国家",
  a.app_code AS "应用",
  a.app_version AS "版本",
  a.network_name AS "买量渠道",
  CASE WHEN a.is_all_row = 1 THEN a.temp_user_count ELSE NULL END AS "注册用户",
  a.standard_scene AS "标准广告场景",
  a.ad_type AS "广告类型", -- 投影输出广告类型
  a.ad_user_count AS "曝光人数",
  a.ad_count AS "曝光次数",
  a.ad_profit AS "广告收益",
  a.ad_click_count AS "点击次数"
FROM aggregated_data a
WHERE (a.is_all_row = 1 AND a.temp_user_count >= 1)
   OR (a.is_all_row = 0 AND a.ad_user_count >= 1)
ORDER BY a.dt DESC, a.country_code, a.app_code, a.is_all_row DESC, a.standard_scene, a.ad_type;

templates.name: 变现渠道
templates.sql:
WITH
-- 1. 基础日志清洗（严格锁定：仅统计当天注册的新用户在当天的行为）
base_log AS (
SELECT
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  -- 1.1 买量渠道清洗
  CASE WHEN LOWER(network_name) = 'instagram installs' THEN 'facebook' ELSE network_name END AS network_name,
  -- 1.2 引入变现渠道
  ad_revenue_network,
  ad_id,
  revenue_usd,
  activity_kind,
  event_name
FROM bi_ods.ods_user_adjust_log_rt
WHERE dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '15 days'
  AND dt <= CURRENT_DATE
  -- 【核心修正】：限制日志日期等于安装日期，确保所有指标仅针对“当天注册的新用户”
  AND CAST(installed_at AS date) = dt
  AND LOWER(app_code) IN ('rm08c','rm06c', 'rm06d','rm10', 'rm12', 'rm12b', 'rm10b', 'rm14') 
)

-- 2. 聚合统计
SELECT
  dt AS "日期",
  country_code AS "国家",
  app_code AS "应用",
  app_version AS "版本",
  network_name AS "买量渠道",
  -- 2.1 变现渠道处理（将未产生广告行为用户的 NULL 转化为“未变现/未知”）
  COALESCE(ad_revenue_network, '未变现/未知') AS "变现渠道",
  
  -- 2.2 注册用户：当天在该变现渠道下有日志的注册新用户数
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS "注册用户",
  
  -- 2.3 行为级去重指标：当天注册的新用户中，在该变现渠道产生曝光的去重人数
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN ad_id END) AS "曝光人数",
  
  -- 2.4 行为级累加指标：仅统计当天新用户在该变现渠道产生的曝光、收益与点击
  COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS "曝光次数",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS "广告收益",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS "点击次数"
FROM base_log
GROUP BY
  dt,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  network_name,
  COALESCE(ad_revenue_network, '未变现/未知')
-- 2.5 过滤掉该细分维度下注册用户数小于 10 的记录
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) >= 10
ORDER BY dt DESC, country_code, app_code, network_name, "变现渠道";

templates.name: 小时同期表
templates.description: 生命周期对比 近期当前时间段 各天差异
templates.sql:
WITH
-- 1. 基础日志清洗
base_log AS (
SELECT
  CAST(installed_at AS date) AS install_date,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(network_name) = 'instagram installs' THEN 'facebook' ELSE network_name END AS network_name,
  ad_id,
  ad_type,
  ad_revenue_network,
  revenue_usd,
  activity_kind,
  event_name,
  (dt - CAST(installed_at AS date)) AS day_x
FROM bi_ods.ods_user_adjust_log_rt
WHERE dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 days'
  AND dt <= CURRENT_DATE
  AND installed_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 days')::text
  AND dt - CAST(installed_at AS date) <= 7
  -- 同期小时对齐：只统计当前整点之前的数据，每天对比口径一致
  AND date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp(created_at)) < date_trunc('hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  AND LOWER(app_code) IN ('rm12') 
),

-- 2. 混合粒度聚合（极致性能：利用 GROUPING SETS 实现无 JOIN 计算）
aggregated_data AS (
SELECT
  install_date,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  network_name,
  
  -- 识别当前行是否为大盘 ALL 汇总行：1 代表是，0 代表是明细拆分行
  GROUPING(day_x) AS is_all_row,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(day_x) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE CAST(day_x AS varchar) END AS day_x,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ad_type) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE COALESCE(ad_type, 'Unknown') END AS ad_type,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ad_revenue_network) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE COALESCE(ad_revenue_network, 'Unknown') END AS ad_revenue_network,
  
  -- 行为级去重指标：曝光人数（大盘行和明细行都会准确去重计算）
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN ad_id END) AS ad_user_count,
  
  -- 行为级累加指标
  COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS ad_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS ad_profit,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS ad_click_count,
  
  -- 属性级去重指标：注册用户临时统计（当天该买量渠道新增的总人数）
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS temp_user_count
FROM base_log
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  -- 组合 1：明细拆分层级 (包含生命周期、广告类型、渠道的所有交叉组合)
  (install_date, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name, day_x, ad_type, ad_revenue_network),
  -- 组合 2：新增用户大盘汇总层级 (无任何变现/生命周期拆分)
  (install_date, app_code, app_version, country_code, network_name)
)
)

-- 3. 主查询：输出最终平铺表，应用“安全隔离”
SELECT
  a.install_date AS "安装日期",
  a.day_x AS "生命周期",
  a.country_code AS "国家",
  a.app_code AS "应用",
  a.app_version AS "版本",
  a.network_name AS "买量渠道",
  
  -- 【方案 B 安全隔离核心】：注册用户在明细行强制置为 NULL，只有在 ALL 大盘行才输出真实值，完美防止透视表求和暴增
  CASE WHEN a.is_all_row = 1 THEN a.temp_user_count ELSE NULL END AS "注册用户",
  
  a.ad_type AS "广告类型",
  a.ad_revenue_network AS "变现渠道",
  a.ad_user_count AS "曝光人数",
  a.ad_count AS "曝光次数",
  a.ad_profit AS "广告收益",
  a.ad_click_count AS "点击次数"
FROM aggregated_data a
-- 【方案 A 过滤逻辑配合】：
-- 3.1 对于大盘行(is_all_row = 1)，过滤掉注册新用户小于 10 的记录
-- 3.2 对于明细行(is_all_row = 0)，过滤掉曝光人数小于 10 的记录
WHERE (a.is_all_row = 1 AND a.temp_user_count >= 10)
   OR (a.is_all_row = 0 AND a.ad_user_count >= 10)
ORDER BY a.install_date DESC, a.country_code, a.app_code, a.is_all_row DESC, a.ad_type, a.ad_revenue_network;

templates.sql:
WITH
-- 1. 全局广告场景映射维表（仅保留 vd002b）
dim_scene_mapping AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    VALUES
    ('vd002b', 'all', 'ALL', 'ALL'),

    ('vd002b', 'load_coldstart', '1冷启动', '1冷启动'),
    ('vd002b', 'load_hotstart', '2热启动', '2热启动'),
    ('vd002b', 'tab_browser', '10浏览器/首页中间大原生', '首页原生'),
    ('vd002b', 'tab_download', '11下载模块底部小原生', '8二级页原生'),
    ('vd002b', 'tab_media', '12媒体库模块底部小原生', '8二级页原生'),
    ('vd002b', 'vip_unlock', '15会员解锁激励视频', '会员解锁激励视频')
  ) AS t (app_code, raw_scene_name, scene_l1_name, scene_l2_name)
),

-- 2. 单次读取清洗日志（剔除买量渠道与广告类型字段）
base_log AS (
SELECT
  CAST(installed_at AS date) AS install_date,
  dt,
  (dt - CAST(installed_at AS date)) AS day_x,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  scene_name,
  ad_id,
  revenue_usd,
  activity_kind,
  event_name
FROM bi_ods.ods_user_adjust_log_rt
WHERE dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '35 days'
  AND dt <= CURRENT_DATE
  AND installed_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '35 days')::text
  AND (dt - CAST(installed_at AS date)) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
  AND LOWER(app_code) = 'vd002b'
),

-- 3. 关联场景映射
scene_mapped AS (
SELECT
  l.install_date,
  l.day_x,
  l.app_code,
  l.app_version,
  l.country_code,
  COALESCE(m.scene_l1_name, l.scene_name) AS scene_l1,
  COALESCE(m.scene_l2_name, '未归类') AS scene_l2,
  l.ad_id,
  l.revenue_usd,
  l.activity_kind,
  l.event_name
FROM base_log l
LEFT JOIN dim_scene_mapping m
  ON LOWER(l.app_code) = m.app_code
 AND LOWER(l.scene_name) = m.raw_scene_name
),

-- 4. 核心单次聚合：GROUPING SETS
aggregated_data AS (
SELECT
  install_date,
  day_x,
  app_code,
  app_version,
  country_code,
  
  -- 1 为大盘汇总行，0 为场景明细行
  GROUPING(scene_l1) AS is_all_scene,
  
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(scene_l1) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE scene_l1 END AS standard_scene,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(scene_l2) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE scene_l2 END AS scene_category,
  
  -- 场景曝光与收益指标
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN ad_id END) AS ad_user_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS ad_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS ad_profit,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN event_name = 'ad_click' THEN 1 END) AS ad_click_count,
  
  -- 当天该生命周期留存总活跃用户
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS temp_active_user_count,
  
  -- 安装当天（D0）的新增注册用户（单次计算，无需二次扫描表）
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_x = 0 THEN ad_id END) AS temp_reg_user_count
FROM scene_mapped
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  -- 组合 1：场景明细层级
  (install_date, day_x, app_code, app_version, country_code, scene_l1, scene_l2),
  -- 组合 2：生命周期大盘层级
  (install_date, day_x, app_code, app_version, country_code)
)
)

-- 5. 主查询：输出最终平铺表
SELECT
  a.install_date AS "安装日期",
  'D' || CAST(a.day_x AS varchar) AS "生命周期",
  
  CASE
    WHEN a.day_x = 0 THEN 'D0'
    WHEN a.day_x BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'D1-D3'
    WHEN a.day_x BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN 'D4-D7'
    WHEN a.day_x BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN 'D8-D14'
    WHEN a.day_x BETWEEN 15 AND 30 THEN 'D15-D30'
    ELSE 'D30+'
  END AS "生命周期阶段",
  
  a.country_code AS "国家",
  a.app_code AS "应用",
  a.app_version AS "版本",
  
  -- 【安全隔离】：大盘行显示真实人数，明细行置为 NULL 防求和翻倍
  CASE WHEN a.is_all_scene = 1 THEN a.temp_reg_user_count ELSE NULL END AS "注册用户",
  CASE WHEN a.is_all_scene = 1 THEN a.temp_active_user_count ELSE NULL END AS "留存活跃用户",
  
  a.scene_category AS "场景大类",
  a.standard_scene AS "标准广告场景",
  
  a.ad_user_count AS "曝光人数",
  a.ad_count AS "曝光次数",
  ROUND(a.ad_profit::numeric, 4) AS "广告收益($)",
  a.ad_click_count AS "点击次数"
FROM aggregated_data a
WHERE (a.is_all_scene = 1 AND a.temp_active_user_count >= 1)
   OR (a.is_all_scene = 0 AND a.ad_user_count >= 1)
ORDER BY 
  a.install_date DESC, 
  a.country_code, 
  a.app_code, 
  a.day_x ASC, 
  a.is_all_scene DESC, 
  a.ad_profit DESC;

-- 所有去重后的标准场景列表
dim_all_scenes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT scene_l1_name AS standard_scene_name FROM dim_scene_mapping
),

-- =========================================================================
-- 2. 基础日志清洗（带出买量渠道 & 单用户买量成本）
-- =========================================================================
base_user_actions AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(l.installed_at AS date) AS install_date,
    l.ad_id,
    LOWER(l.app_code) AS app_code,
    UPPER(l.country_code) AS country_code,
    
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(l.network_name) LIKE '%google%' THEN 'google'
      WHEN LOWER(l.network_name) LIKE '%facebook%' OR LOWER(l.network_name) LIKE '%instagram%' THEN 'facebook'
      WHEN LOWER(l.network_name) LIKE '%tiktok%' OR LOWER(l.network_name) LIKE '%bytedance%' THEN 'tiktok'
      WHEN LOWER(l.network_name) LIKE '%pangle%' THEN 'pangle'
      WHEN LOWER(l.network_name) LIKE '%mintegral%' THEN 'mintegral'
      WHEN LOWER(l.network_name) LIKE '%applovin%' THEN 'applovin'
      WHEN LOWER(l.network_name) = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
      ELSE COALESCE(LOWER(l.network_name), 'unknown')
    END AS network_name,

    COALESCE(m.scene_l1_name, l.scene_name) AS standard_scene_name,
    l.activity_kind,
    l.revenue_usd,
    COALESCE(l.cost_amount, 0) AS cost_usd,
    (l.dt - CAST(l.installed_at AS date)) AS day_x
  FROM bi_ods.ods_user_adjust_log_rt l
  LEFT JOIN dim_scene_mapping m
    ON LOWER(l.app_code) = m.app_code
   AND LOWER(l.scene_name) = m.raw_scene_name
  WHERE 
    l.installed_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '65 days')::text
    AND l.installed_at <= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '31 days')::text
    AND l.dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '65 days'
    AND (l.dt - CAST(l.installed_at AS date)) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
    AND LOWER(l.app_code) IN ('rm08c','rm06c', 'rm06d','rm10', 'rm12', 'rm12b', 'rm10b', 'rm14')
),

-- =========================================================================
-- 3. 用户粒度汇总（D0变现、D30变现、单用户CPI成本）
-- =========================================================================
user_total_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ad_id,
    app_code,
    country_code,
    network_name,
    MAX(cost_usd) AS user_cpi,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN day_x = 0 AND activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN 1 END) AS d0_total_ad_cnt,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN day_x = 0 AND activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS d0_ltv,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN day_x <= 30 AND activity_kind = 'ad_revenue' THEN revenue_usd END), 0) AS d30_ltv
  FROM base_user_actions
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),

-- =========================================================================
-- 4. 用户在「各个广告场景」的 D0 展示次数 (IPU)
-- =========================================================================
user_scene_d0_cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ad_id,
    standard_scene_name,
    COUNT(1) AS scene_d0_ipu
  FROM base_user_actions
  WHERE day_x = 0 AND activity_kind = 'ad_revenue'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),

-- =========================================================================
-- 5. 全场景平铺 + 8 档 IPU + 6 档 eCPM 分箱 (修复括号不匹配问题)
-- =========================================================================
user_scene_bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    u.ad_id,
    u.app_code,
    u.country_code,
    u.network_name,
    s.standard_scene_name,
    COALESCE(sc.scene_d0_ipu, 0) AS scene_d0_ipu,
    u.user_cpi,
    u.d0_ltv,
    u.d30_ltv,
    
    -- 8 档 IPU 分箱
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(sc.scene_d0_ipu, 0) = 0 THEN '0'
      WHEN COALESCE(sc.scene_d0_ipu, 0) = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN COALESCE(sc.scene_d0_ipu, 0) = 2 THEN '2'
      WHEN COALESCE(sc.scene_d0_ipu, 0) = 3 THEN '3'
      WHEN COALESCE(sc.scene_d0_ipu, 0) = 4 THEN '4'
      WHEN COALESCE(sc.scene_d0_ipu, 0) = 5 THEN '5'
      WHEN COALESCE(sc.scene_d0_ipu, 0) = 6 THEN '6'
      ELSE '6+'
    END AS ipu_bucket,

    -- 6 档 eCPM 分箱 (改用闭合中括号，避免 BI 解析器误判)
    CASE 
      WHEN u.d0_total_ad_cnt = 0 THEN '0_NoAd'
      WHEN (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) < 20 THEN '1_eCPM [0-20]'
      WHEN (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) >= 20 AND (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) < 40 THEN '2_eCPM [20-40]'
      WHEN (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) >= 40 AND (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) < 60 THEN '3_eCPM [40-60]'
      WHEN (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) >= 60 AND (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) < 80 THEN '4_eCPM [60-80]'
      WHEN (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) >= 80 AND (u.d0_ltv / u.d0_total_ad_cnt * 1000) < 100 THEN '5_eCPM [80-100]'
      ELSE '6_eCPM [100+]'
    END AS ecpm_bucket
  FROM user_total_stats u
  CROSS JOIN dim_all_scenes s
  LEFT JOIN user_scene_d0_cnt sc
    ON u.ad_id = sc.ad_id
   AND s.standard_scene_name = sc.standard_scene_name
)

-- =========================================================================
-- 6. 主查询：输出【国家代码 × 买量渠道 × 全场景 × 8档IPU × 6档eCPM 综合看板】
-- =========================================================================
SELECT
  country_code AS "国家代码",
  app_code AS "应用",
  network_name AS "买量渠道",
  standard_scene_name AS "标准广告场景",
  ipu_bucket AS "该场景D0_IPU分档",
  ecpm_bucket AS "D0_eCPM分档",
  
  COUNT(ad_id) AS "样本人数",
  
  ROUND(
    MAX(scene_global_corr)::numeric, 
    4
  ) AS "该场景与D30_LTV相关系数",
  
  ROUND(AVG(user_cpi)::numeric, 4) AS "平均_CPI成本",
  ROUND(AVG(d0_ltv)::numeric, 4) AS "平均_D0_LTV",
  ROUND(AVG(d30_ltv)::numeric, 4) AS "平均_D30_真实LTV",
  
  CONCAT(
    ROUND((AVG(d0_ltv) / NULLIF(AVG(user_cpi), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2), 
    '%'
  ) AS "平均_D0_ROI",
  CONCAT(
    ROUND((AVG(d30_ltv) / NULLIF(AVG(user_cpi), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2), 
    '%'
  ) AS "平均_D30_ROI",

  ROUND((AVG(d30_ltv) / NULLIF(AVG(d0_ltv), 0))::numeric, 2) AS "D30_膨胀倍率",
  ROUND(((AVG(d30_ltv) / NULLIF(AVG(d0_ltv), 0)) * 0.6)::numeric, 2) AS "pLTV回传系数"

FROM (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CORR(scene_d0_ipu, d30_ltv) OVER(
      PARTITION BY country_code, app_code, network_name, standard_scene_name
    ) AS scene_global_corr
  FROM user_scene_bucketed
  WHERE d0_ltv > 0
) t
GROUP BY 
  country_code,
  app_code,
  network_name,
  standard_scene_name,
  ipu_bucket,
  ecpm_bucket
HAVING COUNT(ad_id) >= 30
ORDER BY 
  country_code, 
  app_code, 
  network_name, 
  standard_scene_name, 
  ipu_bucket, 
  ecpm_bucket;
